summary: The hashicorp.vault.kv1_secret_get lookup reads KV1 secrets, replacing community.hashi_vault.hashi_vault and the vault_kv1_get lookup. Parameters: auth_method (token or approle, default token), engine_mount_point (default secret; aliases mount_point, secret_mount_path) and required secret (alias secret_path).
questions: What lookup replaces community.hashi_vault.hashi_vault for KV1?
What auth methods does kv1_secret_get support?
What parameter holds the secret path in kv1_secret_get?
